patch:
--- a/WSCUTOFF.cpy
+++ b/WSCUTOFF.cpy
@@ -4 +4 @@
-           05  WS-CUTOFF-CAP         PIC 9(5) VALUE 6000.
+           05  WS-CUTOFF-CAP         PIC 9(5) VALUE 5000.
rationale: The clause-31 cutoff is the lower of one percent of the credit limit and Rs 5000. The staged copybook cap is Rs 6000, so changing it to Rs 5000 corrects the stale threshold while preserving the existing percentage calculation and strict-greater-than comparison.
intended_behavior: For the finite clause-31 cutoff decision, WS-ACTION is CONSENT only when the refund exceeds min(one percent of the credit limit, Rs 5000); otherwise it is ADJUST, including at equality. Consent solicitation and timing, account reversal, and three-working-day timing are unmodeled and unclaimed.
